name: Codersly ERP for Small Business – HRM CRM Accounting Plugin
author: Codersly

sections.description:
Codersly ERP is an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It provides an admin-based company management system with HRM, CRM, Accounting, employee records, leave management, company setup, reports, and business tools.

This free WordPress ERP plugin is designed for small businesses that want to manage essential company operations directly from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Free features include:

  • Dashboard for business overview
  • Company profile and setup wizard scaffold
  • Basic HRM overview for small business teams
  • Option-backed employee, department, designation, announcement, search, import, and export screens
  • Option-backed leave request, holiday, policy, entitlement, calendar, and report screens
  • Option-backed CRM contacts, companies, groups, notes, tasks, and reports screens
  • Option-backed accounting customers, vendors, transactions, products, reports, and settings screens
  • Tools, settings, CSV import/export, and Pro placeholder screens
  • Pro placeholders without premium business logic

Codersly ERP helps small business owners organize HRM, CRM, and Accounting workflows from one WordPress admin area. It is suitable for small teams, agencies, service businesses, and companies that need a simple ERP for Small Business solution inside WordPress.

Premium placeholders include Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Accounting Reimbursements, Inventory, Purchase Orders, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and Integrations.

Get Codersly ERP Pro: https://codersly.com/product/codersly-erp-pro-for-small-business-wordpress-plugin-license/

Data Preservation

Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Codersly ERP.
  3. Go to Codersly ERP in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Set up your company profile and start managing HRM, CRM, and Accounting features.
sections.faq:
What is Codersly ERP?

Codersly ERP is an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It helps small businesses manage HRM, CRM, Accounting, employee information, leave requests, contacts, transactions, and company settings from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Is Codersly ERP suitable for small businesses?

Yes. Codersly ERP is built as a lightweight ERP for Small Business users who want essential business management tools inside WordPress.

Does the Free plugin include license activation?

No. License activation belongs to Codersly ERP Pro. The Free plugin does not create a License menu.

Does the Free plugin contain Pro business logic?

No. The Free plugin only displays upgrade placeholders for Pro features. Premium business logic is not included in the Free version.

Can I manage employees with the Free version?

Yes. The Free version includes option-backed employee, department, designation, announcement, search, import, and export screens.

Can I use Codersly ERP for CRM and Accounting?

Yes. Codersly ERP includes option-backed CRM contacts, companies, groups, notes, tasks, and reports screens, plus accounting customers, vendors, transactions, products, reports, and settings screens.
